啊唐逸你无耻！”“我是你嫂子，你怎么可以做这种事？”唐逸被女人的尖叫声惊醒。睁开眼，他就看到一个女人蜷缩在床角。女人很漂亮，只是此时衣裙不整，大片雪白肌肤露在外面，而且头发凌乱，左脸颊有一个猩红的巴掌印，嘴角还挂着血迹……俨然一副刚刚遭到欺凌的样子！我干的？不，不是我干的。作为龙国特种兵，他还做不出这种事。“你是谁？为何害我？”唐逸脸色骤冷。他双手猛地在床上一撑，想要从床上跃起。结果。轰的一声，身体没跃起来，反而从床上摔了下去，顿时疼得龇牙咧嘴。他这才发现，自己整个身子像是生锈了一般，没有了以前的灵活。怎么回事？唐逸满脸疑惑，这时一股陌生的记忆涌进了他的脑海之中，剧烈的疼痛让他差点又一头栽在地上。等记忆彻底融合，唐逸看着自己乌黑粗糙的双手，一时间懵了。他穿越了。在执行任务的时候被敌人包围，最终和敌人拼得同归于尽，穿越成了大炎王朝吏部侍郎家的少爷。虽然是少爷，但这家伙日子却过得十分凄惨。每日倒马桶洗马桶，劈柴挑水，还要给整个唐家的下人洗衣服裤子……原因无他，因为他这个少爷，在府中如同丧家犬。三年前，他爹唐敬的丑事曝光，原来他在进京赶考前，已经和青梅竹马成亲并且育有三个孩子。当年金榜题名后，设计娶了他母亲柳如玉，是因为外公是吏部尚书，有权有势，傍上外公可以助他平步青云。但在五年前外公意外离世，柳家家道中落，对唐敬没有了利用价值，便被唐敬弃之如敝履。唐敬不顾前身母亲的反对，强行将青梅竹马和三个孩子接回了唐家。最终，母亲气得生了病，不久便撒手人寰了。母亲刚过世，唐敬立即将颜霜玉扶上正妻位。颜霜玉虽然表面温婉，实则心如蛇蝎，纵容她的三个儿子对前身和妹妹非打即骂，各种羞辱。甚至，连吃的，都只能吃下人吃剩下的。要是下人吃没了，那就饿着。前身十八岁能坚持，但妹妹才五岁怎么坚持？无数次饿得哇哇哭。前身性子软弱，生性窝囊，但凡敢有点反抗，换来的就是更狠的打。久而久之，前身成了整个唐府所有人的共用仆人。连以前见到他头都不敢抬的下人，现在见到他都敢往他脸上吐口水，骂一句垃圾了。而前身，也只敢默默将脸上的唾沫擦干。甚至，皇帝有意给唐家一个子嗣赐婚，这是他翻身的机会，他都不敢去争取。反而是颜霜玉怕他抢了儿子的名额，先将他给搞死了……“窝囊，对于敌人，直接干残就是了。”“这么窝窝囊囊的死了，留下敌人祸害妹妹吗？”唐逸脸色难看，对前身恨其不争。“不过你放心，妹妹我会好好照顾的。”提到妹妹，唐逸脸上的冷意才渐渐消融。前世他也有个妹妹，只是身在军营，根本没有时间陪伴那小丫头。现在既然老天爷让自己重活一世，那他，自然不能放过这个弥补遗憾的机会。前世以身许国，这一世，他要为自己而活！不仅要带着妹妹好好活下去，还要活出个名堂来！“唐逸！你个天杀的畜生，我是你嫂子啊……呜呜……”床上的女人看见唐逸愣住，以为他怕了，更加卖力地嚎叫起来。“给我闭嘴！”唐逸猛然回头，一声呵斥。林竹果然停止了嚎叫，但一瞬间的懵逼后，她一张脸顿时阴沉可怕。这废物，不应该吓得向她跪地求饶吗？哪儿来的胆子，敢吼她？！唐逸看着对方，那脸上有为了诬陷他故意画的巴掌印，一时间长长松了一口气：“还好，长得这么丑，还好没让你得手，不然我会恶心一辈子。”林竹面色刹那间僵住。她虽然称不上倾国倾城，但容貌也算卓绝，现在竟然被一个有爹生没娘养的废物说丑？“该死的贱种！你说老娘丑？！”林竹瞬间被激怒，脸色狰狞如厉鬼。“嫂子今日，就好好的教教你，不会说话……会死的！”林竹当即扯着嗓子冲外面喊：“来人啊，非礼啊，来抓流氓啊！”“唐逸，你疯了，我是你嫂子……你不能这样啊！呜呜呜……”声音越发惶恐而凄惨！唐逸看着这个女人夸张的表演，眼底一点点变冷。好啊，既然你们不仁，那我唐逸的崛起，就从你们开始了！“唐逸，你特妈的在干什么？”果然，门外传来怒吼声。随即门被人从外面踹开，一个二十出头的青年，手持棍棒带着四五个家丁冲了进来。青年正是他的二哥，唐浩。见到屋内的画面，唐浩装得满脸愤怒，一蹦三尺高。“唐逸，你特妈的畜生，她是你嫂子。”“对嫂子干出这种猪狗不如的事，我弄死你。”哈哈，弄死你这王八羔子，唐家就是我们的了。唐浩挥动着棍棒，便向着唐逸的脑袋砸了下去。然而。手臂粗的棍子，被唐逸抬手在半空抓住。“草，你还敢挡……”唐浩微愣，没想到唐逸竟然敢反抗，要搁以往，他这时候已经抱头蹲在地上挨打了。结果话没说完，唐逸手一拧，他手中的棍子瞬间脱手而出，落在了唐逸手中。嗖！唐逸随手一扫，棍子直接向他脑袋砸了过来。“啊！”唐浩看着手臂粗的棍子在瞳孔中放大，吓得惨叫。轰！下一秒，棍子直接砸在他的额头上。唐浩四仰八叉地倒在地上，整张脸瞬间全是血。该死的，这个废物怎么敢反抗？他竟然敢反抗？！唐浩又惊又惧，满脸惶恐而床上哭唧唧装委屈的林竹，这时候也瞪大了双眼，难以置信。以前的唐逸胆小懦弱，现在竟然敢还手打人？“唐逸，你敢打我？”“做出这种猪狗不如的事，你还敢打我？爹不会放过你的！”唐浩咆哮。唐逸上前脚踩在他的胸口，手中棍子抵在唐浩的喉咙。“二哥还真慷慨，为了陷害我，竟然连自己的女人都奉献上了，佩服。”“不过我现在心情很不好，疼就憋着，再叫，信不信……我还敢杀你？”唐逸低眸，睨着唐浩。那眼神，仿佛死神凝望。唐浩的声音戛然而止。他捂住嘴，颤抖得不让自己发出声音。就这一瞬间，他很确定，唐逸真敢杀他。“嫂子。”唐逸转身向着林竹走去。林竹吓得一个激灵，面色煞白。“唐逸，你……你想干嘛？你要干嘛？”“你别过来，我……我不和你计较了，你赶紧滚！”林竹有些歇斯底里。“可是，我要和你计较啊！设计陷害我，还大义凛然说不和我计较？你特妈哪儿来的脸！”唐逸猛地抬手，一巴掌甩在林竹的脸上。力道之重，当场将林竹打趴在床上。随即他双手抓住林竹的长发，狠踹几大脚，丢垃圾一般将林竹甩飞出去。霎时间，站在不远处的那四五个家丁全部被撞翻在地。“现在，嫂子可以不用和我计较了。”唐逸微微一笑，义正言辞。“啊啊啊……”听到这话，地上的林竹彻底疯魔了。此时的她蓬头垢面，半张脸已经肿成猪头，原本腮红涂抹的巴掌印，变成了真正的五指血印，嘴角沾染的鸡血也成了口腔破裂溢出的满嘴鲜血。这模样，要多凄惨就有多凄惨。“还愣着干什么？给我弄死他？弄死他！”林竹看着唐逸怨毒怒吼。然而。唐逸一个眼神过去。唐浩捂着头满眼怨毒，却不敢动丝毫。那几个家丁，也被唐逸的气势所威慑，不敢妄动。这时候谁敢动啊！现在的唐逸看上去就是个疯子。唐逸转身往外走。“对了，多谢二哥慷慨！”临出门，他嘴角一勾，“嫂子，很润。”“去告状吧，随便你想怎么告，我在西院等着你爹来找我。”“刚好，我也想要会会这个宠妾灭妻的畜生。”听到唐逸的话，唐浩如遭雷击。他僵硬着脖子看向林竹，老子要你演戏，你特妈让他得手了？

Ah Tang Yi, you are shameless. "I'm your sister-in-law, how can you do such a thing. Tang Yi was awakened by the woman's screams. When he opened his eyes, he saw a woman curled up in the corner of the bed. The woman was very beautiful, but at this time, the dress was irregular, a large area of snow-white skin was exposed outside, and the hair was messy. There was a scarlet palm print on the left cheek, and there were blood stains on the corner of the mouth... It looked like it had just been bullied. I did it. No, I didn't do it. As a Dragon Country Special Forces soldier, he could not do such a thing." Who are you? Why are you hurting me? Tang Yi's face turned cold. He jerked his hands on the bed and tried to jump out of it. The result. With a boom, the body did not jump, but instead fell off the bed, suddenly grinning with pain. Only then did he realize that his entire body seemed to be rusty and not as flexible as before. What happened? Tang Yi's face was full of doubts. At this moment, an unfamiliar memory flooded into his mind. Severe pain almost drove him to the ground again. After the memories were completely fused, Tang Yi looked at his rough black hands and was dazed for a moment. He crossed over. Surrounded by the enemy while performing tasks, he eventually fought with the enemy and became a young master of the Lang family of the Ministry of the Great Fire Dynasty. Although he was a young master, this guy had a very miserable life. Dump the toilet bowl every day, chop wood and fetch water, and wash laundry and pants for the whole Tang family... for no reason, because he is like a bereaved dog in the mansion.
Three years ago, the scandal of his father, Tang Jing, was exposed. It turned out that before he entered Beijing to catch up with the exam, he was already married to Qingmei Zhu Ma and had three children. After the title of the Golden List, he designed to marry his mother, Liu Ruyu, because his grandfather was a Shangshu of the Ministry of Public Affairs and had power. Grandfather could help him calm down. However, five years ago, my grandfather died unexpectedly, and Liu's family fell in the way. There was no use value for Tang Jing, so he was abandoned by Tang Jing. Despite the opposition of the previous mother, Tang Jing forcibly returned Qingmei Zhu Ma and his three children to the Tang family. Eventually, her mother became so angry that she fell ill, and soon after, she lost her hand. Just after her mother died, Tang Jing immediately raised Yan Shuangyu to the position of wife. Although Yan Shuangyu was gentle on the surface, she was really like a snake and a scorpion. She indulged her three sons to scold her predecessor and younger sister and various humiliations. Even food can only be eaten by people. If the next person runs out of food, they'll be hungry. The predecessor could persevere at the age of eighteen, but how could her sister persevere only at the age of five? Wow, I've cried so hungry countless times. The predecessor's nature was weak, and he was born with a nest sac. However, if he dared to resist a little, he would be hit even harder in return. Over time, the predecessor became a common servant for everyone in the entire Tang Dynasty. Even those who didn't dare to lift his head before saw him, now they dare to spit in his face and scold him with a word of garbage. And the predecessor only dared to silently wipe the spit from his face. Even, the emperor intended to give the Tang family a son to marry. This was his chance to turn around, and he didn't dare to fight for it.
Instead, Yan Shuangyu was afraid that he would steal his son's spot and kill him first... "Cowboy, for the enemy, it's just direct crippling." Such a cowardly death, leaving the enemy to scourge her sister? Tang Yi looked ugly and hated his predecessor indisputably. "But don't worry, I'll take good care of you. Referring to her younger sister, the coldness on Tang Yi's face gradually dissipated. In his previous life, he also had a sister, but he was in the military camp and had no time to accompany the little girl. Now that God has allowed himself to live again, he naturally cannot let go of this opportunity to make up for his regrets. In his previous life as Xu, in this life, he would live for himself. Not only must he live a good life with his sister, but he must also live a famous life." Tang Yi. You goddamn beast, I'm your sister-in-law... "The woman in the bed saw Tang Yi stunned and thought he was scared, and howled harder." Shut up. "Tang Yi suddenly turned around and shouted. Lin Zhu really stopped howling, but after a moment of bewilderment, her face was suddenly gloomy and scary. This bastard shouldn't be so frightened that he knelt down and begged her for forgiveness. Where come the courage, dare to yell at her. Tang Yi looked at the other party, and there was a slap print on his face to frame him for deliberately drawing. He was relieved for a long time:" Fortunately, he looks so ugly, but fortunately he didn't let you win, otherwise I will be disgusted for a lifetime. Lin Zhu's face froze for a moment. Although she could not be called a leaner, her appearance was also remarkable, and now she was actually said to be ugly by a waste with fathers and no mothers. "Damn bastard. You said the old lady was ugly.
Lin Zhu was instantly enraged and his face was as fierce as a ghost. "Sister-in-law, teach you well today, you can't talk... you will die. Immediately, Lin Zhu pulled his throat and shouted outside," Someone, disrespectful, come and catch the hooligan. "Tang Yi, you're crazy. I'm your sister-in-law... you can't do this. Sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sob sobs. Tang Yi watched the woman's exaggerated performance and his eyes turned a little cold. Okay, since you are unkind, then my rise to Tang Yi will start with you." Tang Yi, what the hell are you doing? ”Sure enough, an angry roar came from outside the door. Immediately, the door was kicked open from the outside. A young man in his early twenties rushed in with four or five family members with sticks. The young man was his second brother, Tang Hao. Seeing the picture inside the house, Tang Hao pretended to be full of anger and jumped three feet high." Tang Yi, your aunt's beast, she is your sister-in-law. "I'll kill you for doing such a bad thing to my sister-in-law." Haha, kill Wang Baziao, the Tang family is ours. Tang Hao waved his stick and smashed it into Tang Yi's head. However, the stick with the thick arm was caught in mid-air by Tang Yi's raised hand. "Grass, you still dare to block..." Tang Hao was stunned. I didn't expect Tang Yi to dare to resist. He wanted to put the past aside. He was already hugging his head and crouching on the ground at this time. As a result, Tang Yi's hand twisted, and the stick in his hand instantly fell off and fell into Tang Yi's hands. Swoosh. Tang Yi swept around and the stick hit him directly on the head. "Ahh.
Tang Hao looked at the thick-armed stick enlarged in his pupils, screaming in fright. Boom. The next second, the stick slammed directly into his forehead. Tang Hao fell to the ground, his whole face instantly covered in blood. Damn it, how dare this scum resist. He dared to resist. Tang Hao was scared and frightened, and Lin Zhu, who was crying and pretending to be wronged on the bed, opened his eyes in disbelief at this time. Tang Yi used to be timid and cowardly, but now he dared to fight back. "Tang Yi, don't you dare hit me." You still dare to beat me if you do something like this. Dad won't let you go. Tang Hao roared. Tang Yi stepped forward and stepped on his chest, and the stick in his hand pressed against Tang Hao's throat. "Second Brother is really generous. In order to frame me, he even dedicated his own woman and admired it." But I'm in a very bad mood right now. If it hurts, I'll hold back. If I scream again, believe it or not... I'll still dare to kill you. Tang Yi looked down at Tang Hao. That look was like a death gaze. Tang Hao's voice stopped abruptly. He covered his mouth and trembled so that he could not make a sound. At this moment, he was very sure that Tang Yi really dared to kill him. "Sister-in-law." Tang Yi turned and walked towards Lin Zhu. Lin Zhu was frightened and had a pale complexion. "Tang Yi, you... what do you want? What are you going to do?" "Don't come over, I... I don't care about you, you get out of here. Lin Zhu was a little hysterical." However, I want to make a deal with you. The design framed me, and Yi Yi suddenly said that he would not bother with me. Where did your special mother's face come from? ”Tang Yi raised his hand fiercely and slapped Lin Zhu on the face.
The weight of the force was heavy, and Lin Zhu was lying on the bed on the spot. Immediately after that, he grabbed Lin Zhu's long hair with both hands, kicked a few feet hard, and threw away the garbage and flung Lin Zhu out. For a moment, the four or five family members standing not far away were all knocked to the ground. "Now, my sister-in-law can stop thinking about me. Tang Yi smiled, righteous." Ahhhh... "Hearing this, the forest bamboo on the ground was completely mad. At this time, her face was dirty, and half of her face had swollen into a pig's head. The palm print that had originally been painted with blush turned into a real five-finger blood mark, and the chicken blood stained at the corner of her mouth also became bloody from the rupture of her mouth. This look, how miserable it is to be miserable." Why are you still standing there? Kill him for me. Kill him. "Lin Zhu looked at Tang Yi and roared with resentment. However. Tang Yi glanced past. Tang Hao covered his eyes with bitterness, but he did not dare to move at all. Those families were also deterred by Tang Yi's aura and did not dare to move. Who dares to move at this time? Now Tang Yi looked like a madman. Tang Yi turned and walked out." By the way, thank you Second Brother for your generosity. "Before going out, he caught the corner of his mouth." Sister-in-law, it's very moist. "Go and sue, whatever you want to sue, I'll wait for your father to come to me in the west yard." Just in time, I also want to be able to kill my wife with this pet concubine beast. Hearing Tang Yi's words, Tang Haoru was struck by lightning. He stiffened his neck and looked at Lin Zhu. Lao Zi wanted you to act. Your special mother made him successful.
